title: Situation engineering for reliable evidence use in artificial intelligence (SAGE / SituationCatch-Bench)
description: Reference implementation, SituationCatch-Bench diagnostic (4,200 items), and the audited single-family Gemini E5 pilot (direct/structured/situation, RAG and agentic baselines) for the paper 'Situation engineering for reliable evidence use in artificial intelligence'. Includes the deterministic benchmark generator, evaluation harness, integrity audit, statistics, and item-level raw responses.
